title: Load Environment and Recipient Config
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Load Environment and Recipient Config.
learning_objectives: Explain load environment and recipient config using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for load environment and recipient config

load_config builds EnvKeys, CreationRule, and DecryptPolicy; recipients are validated.

Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
